subject.title: ci(loc): exclude the i18n catalog and make baseline raises reviewable

question: Should the LOC ratchet intentionally allow baseline increases after ordinary code review, replacing the machine-enforced base-ref prohibition introduced by the predecessor PR?
rationale: This changes the repository’s enforcement boundary rather than merely repairing an implementation bug; CI cannot verify that a baseline increase received the intended approval.

options.title: Accept review-enforced raises
options.body: After resolving conflicts and adding actual command proof, rely on visible baseline diffs and explicit reviewer approval, matching the stated deadcode-ratchet pattern.

options.title: Retain machine enforcement
options.body: Keep the versioned comparison and design a narrow explicit approval or override mechanism for exceptional baseline additions and increases.

recommendation.title: Accept review-enforced raises
recommendation.body: After resolving conflicts and adding actual command proof, rely on visible baseline diffs and explicit reviewer approval, matching the stated deadcode-ratchet pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ratchet and authored the proposed enforcement-policy change, making them the clearest owner for confirming its intended contract.
